configuration.context_tokenizer: Pinned E5 tokenizer; proxy, not the generation/chat tokenizer
configuration.context_format: [document_name#chunk_index] + newline + raw chunk; blank line between chunks; no embedding prefixes/special tokens
configuration.policy: Neighbors: each top10 seed then previous and next final chunk in same document/language and ACL; deduplicate; skip whole candidates that do not fit. No partial chunks or gold-label selection.
configuration.timing: Planning/tokenization only, excludes embedding/DB/network/generation and evidence scoring. Does not estimate end-to-end latency.
configuration.limitations: Exploratory post-hoc fixed-budget ablation on 20 paired intents/80 cases; Q14 full-intent excluded. Context evidence coverage can use >10 chunks and is not Recall@10. No generation quality/cost measured. All policy variants predeclared before results, unchanged vectors. Context tokens are not encoder input length and can exceed 512.
